marks_structure.extra_time_note: Koi extra reading time nahi. 3 ghante mein hi poora paper solve karna hai.
marks_structure.internal_assessment_note: Theory 80 mein se 27 marks (33%) aur overall 33% zaroori hain. 2022 se MP Board ne passing criteria revise kiya hai.

paper_overview.sets_note: MP Board mein Set A, B, C, D hote hain. Sab sets mein same questions, sirf order ya numerical figures thode badal jaate hain.
paper_overview.language_of_attempt: Hindi ya English dono allowed. Hindi aur English dono versions paper mein printed aate hain. Discrepancy ki condition mein Hindi version final maana jayega.
paper_overview.all_compulsory_note: Sabhi 23 questions hal karna anivary hai — sirf OR option vale mein ek chunna hai, skip nahi kar sakte. Q6 se Q23 tak sab 18 questions mein 'अथवा / OR' option milega — har ek mein internal choice hai.
paper_overview.ncert_enough: MP Board Class 12 Accountancy ka syllabus NCERT par based hai. NCERT ki dono books (Part 1 — Partnership & Company Accounts, Part 2 — Analysis of Financial Statements) sab solve karo. Hindi medium wale bhi NCERT Hindi edition ya 'Jain & Narang' jaise references use kar sakte hain.
paper_overview.official_scheme_note: Partnership accounts (Ch 1-5) = ~32 marks aur Company accounts (Ch 6-7) = ~16-18 marks, dono milakar ~60% paper. Financial statements + Ratio + Cash Flow = ~15-18 marks.
prescribed_textbooks: NCERT Accountancy Part II (Company Accounts + Analysis of Financial Statements)

question_types_in_exam.summary: MP Board Class 12 Accountancy mein 7 types ke questions: MCQ (1), Fill Blank (1), True/False (1), Match (1), One word (1), Short 2 mark, Short 3 mark, Long 4 mark. Total = 80 marks.

types.how_to_attempt: Option (a)/(b)/(c)/(d) likhna hai — explanation ki zaroorat nahi. 1 mark ke liye 30 second se zyada mat lagao.
types.mostly_from: Partnership Act 1932, interest on capital in absence of deed (6%/nil), super profit definition, Table F (interest on calls 10%), Accounting Standard numbers (AS-3 for cash flow), Schedule III Balance Sheet, dissolution accounting heads.

types.how_to_attempt: Ek shabd / phrase / naam likhna hai. Common answers: bank overdraft → Realisation A/c, cash equivalents, AS-3, sacrificing/gaining ratio, 'limited' word, etc.
types.mostly_from: Profit-loss ratio in absence of deed (equal), calls in arrears rate (Table F 10%), current liabilities period (12 months), types of debentures, reserves.

types.how_to_attempt: Sirf 'सत्य' ya 'असत्य' (True/False) likho. No reasoning needed.
types.mostly_from: Partnership deed compulsory? (False), Revaluation A/c is real A/c? (False — Nominal), debentureholders are owners? (False — creditors), paid-up capital > called-up? (False), bank overdraft → Realisation on dissolution? (True).

types.how_to_attempt: Column A ki har item ko Column B se match karo aur pair likho.
types.mostly_from: Bearer debentures → transfer through delivery, Shareholders → owners, Preference shares → fixed rate, Equity shares → variable return, Partnership deed → not compulsory, Purchased goodwill → shown as asset.

types.how_to_attempt: Ek shabd ya ek sentence. Naam, rate, account name, ya short definition.
types.mostly_from: Deceased partner's payment to → Legal representative, Cash Flow AS → AS-3, Bank overdraft on dissolution → Realisation A/c, goodwill basis → super profit/average profit, Partnership Act → 1932.

types.how_to_attempt: Definition + ek example ya 2 features/differences. 2 marks = 1 mark concept + 1 mark example/difference.
types.mostly_from: Partnership deed definition, interest on drawings (product method), sacrificing/gaining ratio calculation, legal representative, realisation vs revaluation, share meaning, calls in advance, zero-coupon debenture, secured debenture, Current Ratio calculation, net profit ratio, cash flow meaning, accounting ratio objectives.

types.how_to_attempt: Full working for numerical OR 3 differences/features. 3 marks = concept (1) + entries/steps (1.5) + result (0.5).
types.mostly_from: Forfeiture journal entry, Revaluation Account journal entries, Goodwill by super-profit method, Balance Sheet main heads (Schedule III) classification, Shares vs Debentures (3 differences), Types of preference shares, Retiring partner's loan account, Cash flow from financing examples.

types.how_to_attempt: Full numerical with all calculations OR 4 differences/features with explanation. 4 marks = format (0.5) + adjustments/entries (2.5) + result (1).
types.mostly_from: Profit & Loss Appropriation Account (with guarantee), Revaluation Account + Partners' Capital Account, Goodwill valuation (super profit / capitalisation method), Share issue journal entries (application to final call), Forfeiture + Reissue journal entries, Partnership deed provisions (4 rules), Current Ratio full numerical, Shares vs Debentures (4 differences).
types.word_limit: 120 shabd ya numerical ke liye poora working

paper_pattern.note: 3 hours, 80 marks, 23 questions, 4 sections. Q1-5 objective (~31 marks), Q6-15 VSA (20 marks), Q16-19 Short (12 marks), Q20-23 Long (16 marks).
paper_pattern.internal_choice_note: Q6 se Q23 tak sab 18 questions mein 'अथवा / OR' option milega — har ek mein internal choice hai.
paper_pattern.or_questions_note: Q1-Q5 tak objective questions mein koi internal choice nahi — sab attempt karna compulsory.

difficulty_distribution.note: MP Board Accountancy paper overall MEDIUM difficulty ka hota hai. Partnership ke numericals thode lamba lagte hain lekin scoring hote hain. Ratio aur Cash Flow mein formulas yaad ho to 18-20 marks easy.

sections.name: Section A — Objective (MCQ + Fill blanks + True/False + Match + One word)
sections.notes: 35-40 min Section A se 28-30 marks nikalna target rakho — koi negative marking nahi, sab attempt karo. Sirf MCQ mein time lagao.

sections.name: Section B — Very Short Answer (VSA)
sections.breakdown: Har question mein अथवा/OR option. Definitions, do antar (differences), short concept explain, 1-2 step numericals.

sections.name: Section C — Short Answer
sections.breakdown: Har question mein OR option. Short journal entries, formula based calculations, 2-3 point comparisons, main-heads classification.

sections.name: Section D — Long Answer
sections.breakdown: Har question mein OR option. Full P&L Appropriation Account, Revaluation Account, Goodwill calculation, Share issue journal entries with forfeiture, Current Ratio full numerical.

chapters.name: Accounting for Partnership — Basic Concepts
topics: Partnership definition — Indian Partnership Act 1932 (Section 4)
Essential features — 2+ persons, agreement, business, profit sharing, mutual agency
Partnership Deed — meaning, contents, importance
Provisions in absence of partnership deed — profit-loss ratio EQUAL, no interest on capital, 6% interest on partner's loan, no salary/commission, no interest on drawings
Fixed Capital Method vs Fluctuating Capital Method (differences, current account)
Profit & Loss Appropriation Account — salary, commission, interest on capital, interest on drawings
Interest on Drawings — product method, average period method
Guarantee of minimum profit to a partner (from one partner or by firm)
Past adjustments / omission entries

chapters.name: Reconstitution of Partnership — Change in Profit Sharing Ratio
topics: Reconstitution meaning — change in profit ratio, admission, retirement, death
Sacrificing ratio = Old ratio − New ratio
Gaining ratio = New ratio − Old ratio
Treatment of accumulated profits and reserves (distributed in OLD ratio)
Revaluation of assets and liabilities — Revaluation Account (Nominal A/c)
Adjustment of goodwill through sacrificing/gaining partners
chapters.note: Hindi: साझेदारी का पुनर्गठन — लाभ विभाजन अनुपात में परिवर्तन | Difficulty: Medium

chapters.name: Admission of a Partner
topics: Reasons for admission of a new partner
Rights of a new partner — share in profit, share in assets
New profit sharing ratio and sacrificing ratio calculation
Treatment of Goodwill — premium brought in cash (distributed in sacrificing ratio), hidden goodwill, goodwill already in books (written off first)
Revaluation Account — assets and liabilities revalued
Accumulated profits and reserves — distributed to old partners in old ratio
Adjustment of capital — capital brought in proportion to profit share
Journal entries for admission
chapters.note: Hindi: नए साझेदार का प्रवेश | Difficulty: Medium-Hard

chapters.name: Retirement and Death of a Partner
topics: Modes of retirement — with consent, as per agreement, notice
New profit sharing ratio and gaining ratio
Treatment of goodwill on retirement (compensation from gaining partners)
Revaluation Account on retirement
Amount due to retiring partner — capital + interest + share of goodwill + reserves + revaluation profit − drawings − losses
Payment options — lump sum, instalments with interest, loan account
Death of a partner — profit till date of death (time basis or sales basis)
Legal representative / executor's account
Joint Life Policy (JLP) — treatment
chapters.note: Hindi: साझेदार की सेवानिवृत्ति एवं मृत्यु | Difficulty: Medium-Hard

chapters.name: Dissolution of Partnership Firm
topics: Dissolution of partnership vs dissolution of firm (difference)
Modes of dissolution — by agreement, notice, court order, compulsory, contingency
Compulsory dissolution — insolvency of all partners, illegal business
Realisation Account — sale of all assets, payment of all liabilities
Transfer of assets (book value) and liabilities to Realisation A/c
Treatment of unrecorded assets/liabilities
Bank overdraft → transferred to Realisation A/c
Undistributed profit/reserve → Partners' Capital A/c (old ratio)
Payment of expenses of realisation
Order of settlement of accounts (Sec 48)
chapters.note: Hindi: साझेदारी फर्म का विघटन | Difficulty: Medium

chapters.name: Accounting for Share Capital
topics: Company — meaning, features (perpetual succession, limited liability, artificial person created by law)
Types of companies — Private, Public, One Person Company
Types of share capital — Authorised / Nominal, Issued, Subscribed, Called-up, Paid-up, Reserve Capital
Types of shares — Equity (Ordinary) and Preference (Cumulative, Non-cumulative, Participating, Convertible, Redeemable)
Issue of shares at par, premium, discount
Oversubscription — full allotment, pro-rata allotment, rejection
Calls in arrears — interest charged @ 10% p.a. (Table F)
Calls in advance — interest paid @ 12% p.a. (Table F)
Forfeiture of shares — procedure, journal entry (Share Capital A/c Dr. with called-up amount)
Reissue of forfeited shares — at discount (not more than forfeited amount), profit transferred to Capital Reserve
Securities Premium — uses (Sec 52 of Companies Act 2013)

chapters.name: Issue and Redemption of Debentures
topics: Debenture — meaning, features (written instrument of debt, fixed rate of interest, repayment after fixed period)
Debentureholders — creditors of company (NOT owners), no voting rights

Types of debentures — (a) From Security view: Secured / Unsecured (b) From Registration: Registered / Bearer (c) From Redemption: Redeemable / Irredeemable (d) From Convertibility: Convertible / Non-convertible (e) From Coupon: Zero-coupon / Specific rate
Issue of debentures at par, premium, discount
Issue for consideration other than cash (for purchase of assets or machinery)
Issue as collateral security
Interest on debentures (paid whether profit or not)
Writing off loss on issue of debentures

chapters.name: Financial Statements of a Company
topics: Financial Statements — meaning, nature, objectives, importance, limitations
Balance Sheet as per Schedule III of Companies Act 2013
Main heads in Balance Sheet: I. Equity and Liabilities — (1) Shareholders' Funds (2) Non-Current Liabilities (3) Current Liabilities; II. Assets — (1) Non-Current Assets (2) Current Assets
Sub-heads under each main head (Share capital, Reserves & Surplus, Long-term borrowings, Trade payables, Fixed assets, Inventories, Trade receivables, Cash & cash equivalents)
Statement of Profit and Loss format
Classification of items — Reserves & Surplus (General Reserve, Capital Reserve, Securities Premium, Surplus)
chapters.note: Hindi: कंपनी के वित्तीय विवरण | Difficulty: Easy-Medium

chapters.name: Analysis of Financial Statements — Ratio Analysis
topics: Tools of analysis — Comparative Statements, Common Size Statements, Ratio Analysis, Cash Flow Statement
Horizontal vs Vertical analysis
Objectives and limitations of financial analysis / ratio analysis
Types of ratios: (1) Liquidity (2) Solvency (3) Activity/Turnover (4) Profitability
Liquidity Ratios — Current Ratio = Current Assets / Current Liabilities (Ideal 2:1), Quick Ratio = Quick Assets / Current Liabilities (Ideal 1:1)
Solvency Ratios — Debt-Equity Ratio, Total Assets to Debt, Proprietary Ratio, Interest Coverage
Activity Ratios — Inventory Turnover, Debtors Turnover, Creditors Turnover, Working Capital Turnover
Profitability Ratios — Gross Profit Ratio, Net Profit Ratio, Operating Ratio, Return on Investment (ROI)
chapters.note: Hindi: वित्तीय विवरणों का विश्लेषण — अनुपात विश्लेषण | Difficulty: Medium

chapters.name: Cash Flow Statement
topics: Cash Flow Statement — meaning, objectives, importance, limitations
Accounting Standard 3 (AS-3, Revised)
Cash and Cash Equivalents — cash, bank, short-term investments (≤3 months)
Classification of activities — (1) Operating (2) Investing (3) Financing
Operating Activities — principal revenue-producing activities (cash from customers, to suppliers, employees, interest paid by financial companies)
Investing Activities — purchase/sale of fixed assets, investments, interest received, dividend received (non-financial co.)
Financing Activities — issue of shares/debentures, repayment of loans, dividend paid, interest on debentures paid
Cash flow from operating activities — Indirect Method (Net profit + non-cash + non-operating items ± changes in working capital)
chapters.note: Hindi: रोकड़ प्रवाह विवरण | Difficulty: Medium

important_topics: Partnership definition — Indian Partnership Act 1932 (Section 4)
Essential features — 2+ persons, agreement, business, profit sharing, mutual agency

important_formulas: Interest on drawings = Total Products × Rate/100 × 1/12
Average Period (monthly drawings, beginning of month) = (n+1)/2 × Drawings
Average Period (end of month) = (n-1)/2 × Drawings
Guaranteed partner deficiency = Guaranteed amount − Actual share (to be borne by guaranteeing partners in agreed ratio)
Interest on capital = Capital × Rate × Time

important_formulas: Current Ratio = Current Assets / Current Liabilities
Quick Ratio = (Current Assets − Inventory − Prepaid Expenses) / Current Liabilities
Working Capital = Current Assets − Current Liabilities
Gross Profit Ratio = (Gross Profit / Revenue from Operations) × 100
Net Profit Ratio = (Net Profit / Revenue from Operations) × 100
Operating Ratio = ((Cost of Revenue + Operating Expenses) / Revenue from Operations) × 100
Debt-Equity Ratio = Long-term Debts / Shareholders' Funds

key_concepts_masterlist: Partnership Act: Indian Partnership Act, 1932 (Section 4 defines partnership)
Max members in partnership firm: 50 (as per Rule 10, Companies Act 2013 — NOT 100 or 200)
Min partners: 2 persons
Interest on capital (no deed): NIL / NOT paid
Interest on partner's loan (no deed): 6% p.a.
Profit-loss ratio (no deed): Equal
Salary/commission to partner (no deed): NIL / Not allowed
Interest on drawings (no deed): NIL / Not charged
Super Profit: Excess of Average Profit over Normal Profit (Average Profit − Normal Profit)
Normal Profit: Capital Employed × Normal Rate of Return
Goodwill (Super Profit method): Super Profit × No. of years' purchase
Goodwill (Capitalisation method): Super Profit × (100 / Normal Rate)
Types of goodwill: Purchased goodwill (shown as asset) and Self-generated goodwill (NOT shown)
Sacrificing Ratio: Old Ratio − New Ratio
Gaining Ratio: New Ratio − Old Ratio
Revaluation A/c nature: Nominal Account
Realisation A/c nature: Nominal Account (prepared on dissolution)
Bank overdraft on dissolution: Transferred to Realisation A/c (NOT Bank A/c)
Undistributed profit on dissolution: Transferred to Partners' Capital A/c in OLD ratio
Order of payment on dissolution (Sec 48): (1) Third party debts (2) Partner's loan (3) Partner's capital (4) Balance to partners in profit ratio
Deceased partner's payment: Legal representative / Executor
Calls in arrears — Interest rate (Table F): 10% p.a.
Calls in advance — Interest rate (Table F): 12% p.a.
Max discount on shares: Not allowed under Companies Act 2013 (except sweat equity)
Max premium on shares: No limit
Forfeiture — Share Capital A/c debited with: Called-up amount per share × no. of shares forfeited
Profit on reissue transferred to: Capital Reserve A/c
Securities Premium uses (Sec 52): Bonus shares, writing off preliminary expenses, writing off discount on shares/debentures, premium on redemption, buy-back of shares
Balance Sheet format: As per Schedule III of Companies Act 2013
Cash Flow Statement AS: AS-3 (Revised)
Ideal Current Ratio: 2:1
Ideal Quick Ratio: 1:1
Debentureholders: Creditors of company (NOT owners, no voting rights)
Equity shareholders: Owners of company (voting rights, variable dividend)
Preference shareholders dividend: Fixed rate, paid before equity
Bearer debentures: Transferable by mere delivery (no registration)
Zero-coupon debenture: No periodic interest; issued at discount, redeemed at face value
Perpetual / Irredeemable debenture: No fixed maturity date; redeemed only on winding up

important_formula_sheets.note: Accountancy mein formulas aur ratios bahut important hain. Ch 1 (Partnership), Ch 9 (Ratios), Ch 10 (Cash Flow) se numericals har saal aate hain.

formulas: Interest on drawings = Total Products × Rate/100 × 1/12
Average Period (monthly drawings, beginning of month) = (n+1)/2 × Drawings
Average Period (end of month) = (n-1)/2 × Drawings
Guaranteed partner deficiency = Guaranteed amount − Actual share (to be borne by guaranteeing partners in agreed ratio)
Interest on capital = Capital × Rate × Time

formulas_by_chapter.chapter_name: Reconstitution of Partnership — Change in Profit Sharing Ratio
formulas: Sacrificing Ratio = Old Ratio − New Ratio (positive = sacrifice)
Gaining Ratio = New Ratio − Old Ratio (positive = gain)
Revaluation profit/loss distributed in OLD ratio
New ratio when new partner takes share equally from both: New share of old = Old share − (share given/2)
Hidden goodwill = Implied capital of firm − Actual capital of all partners
Implied capital = New partner's capital × reciprocal of his share

formulas_by_chapter.chapter_name: Retirement and Death of a Partner
formulas: Gaining Ratio = New Ratio − Old Ratio
Retiring partner's share of goodwill = Firm's goodwill × His share
Profit till date of death = Last year's profit × (Months till death / 12) × deceased partner's share
Interest on loan to retiring partner = 6% p.a. (if nothing mentioned)
Realisation profit/loss = (Amount realised from assets) − (Book value of assets + Liabilities paid + Realisation expenses)
Realisation profit distributed to partners in PROFIT SHARING RATIO (not capital ratio)
Forfeiture entry: Share Capital A/c Dr. (called-up amount) | To Share Forfeiture A/c (amount received) | To Calls in Arrears A/c (amount not received)
Reissue at discount = loss ≤ amount forfeited on those shares
Profit on reissue = Amount forfeited on reissued shares − Discount on reissue → transferred to Capital Reserve
Pro-rata allotment ratio = Shares applied / Shares allotted
Interest on debentures = Face value × Rate × Time (paid even if loss)
Issue at discount: Bank A/c Dr. (amount received) + Discount on Issue A/c Dr. | To Debentures A/c
Issue at premium: Bank A/c Dr. | To Debentures A/c | To Securities Premium A/c

paper_difficulty_analysis.note: MP Board Accountancy paper overall MEDIUM difficulty ka hota hai. Partnership ke numericals thode lamba lagte hain lekin scoring hote hain. Ratio aur Cash Flow mein formulas yaad ho to 18-20 marks easy.
most_scoring_sections: Easy — 25-28 marks aasaani se aa sakte hain agar concepts clear ho. Har saal similar format.
Easy to Medium — 2-mark VSA mein definition, formula, chota numerical. OR option se easy chuno.
most_difficult_sections: Medium-Hard — Full numerical (P&L App, Revaluation, Share issue) ya 4-point comparison. Practice chahiye.

tips: Section A se 28-31 marks nikalna PAKKA karo — ye sabse safe marks hain, no internal choice lekin no negative marking bhi.
Partnership chapters (1-5) = 33 marks — sabse important. P&L Appropriation aur Revaluation Account roz practice karo.
Ch 6 (Share Capital) ki journal entries 5 saal se har paper mein 4-mark Long Answer mein aa rahi hain — zaroor master karo.
Har numerical mein 'To' aur 'By' side clearly likho, total tally karo, working notes alag likho.
OR option mein NUMERICAL vs THEORY ka choice mile to apni strength dekhke chuno — agar numerical confident ho to wo, warna theory.
Ratio Analysis mein 'ideal ratio' yaad rakho — Current 2:1, Quick 1:1, Debt-Equity 2:1 (ideal).
Cash Flow mein activity classification (Operating/Investing/Financing) seedha MCQ/Fill blank mein aata hai — yaad karo.
AS-3 = Cash Flow, Schedule III = Balance Sheet — ye facts 100% pakke MCQ/Fill blank.
Narration (Being...) likhna na bhoolo — 0.5 marks extra har journal entry mein.
MP Board PYQ (2020-2025) ke solutions mpboardonline.com se download karo — SAME questions repeat hote hain.
Hindi medium aur English medium dono padhke practice karo — discrepancy ho to Hindi final hai.
Diagrams/formats (P&L Appropriation, Balance Sheet, Revaluation A/c) ruler se banao — presentation ke marks milte hain.

time_allocation.note: Objective sab pehle. 1 minute per question. Confused ho to circle karo, last mein wapas aao.

12-13 minute per long answer. Format pehle banao, phir adjustments.
Last mein Objective wapas check karo — ek-do marks aasani se badh sakte hain.
